hypotheses.calibration: The E13 development cascade shows 129 family-policy and 25 value/joint-policy rejections. More independent original calibration support may improve accepted commands under unchanged minimum support/precision/UNKNOWN criteria.

v3_calibration.policy_fit: original calibration split, excluding custom enrollments and pairs

v3_pooled.policy_fit: original calibration plus dev policy_fit, excluding custom enrollments and pairs

splits: No fitting of acoustic weights. Policy fitting on declared calibration populations only. Original dev selection compares policies. Original human test is historical regression already used by E12/E13/E14; never called new blind evidence.

primary_test.population: Original 4314 human test recordings including 1783 finite references
primary_test.thresholds: Unchanged >=20 accepts, >=95% value/joint precision, >=99% color, family shared <=1% UNKNOWN; use declared calibration population, not test

selection: Same rank as E13: dev >=95% complete precision and <=1% UNKNOWN first, then complete recall, minimum family recall, precision. Original dev selection only. Preserve both unchanged-policy control and chosen policy result. Lock before v3 test.

separate_reports.deterministic: v3 fixed-command comparison; retain E13/E14 custom and number findings since weights unchanged. Any policy-dependent numeric output must be rescored explicitly.

synthetic_scope: Existing labeled Qwen whole-utterance recordings reused without modifying their manifest or voices. Any additional synthesis requires a separately frozen stress-data plan, original full utterances, and provenance. No word splicing.
protected: Installed artifacts, wake/VAD config, published E12 package, all historical studies and original datasets. No files deleted or physically pruned.
ignore_gate: Existing committed scoped rules passed; no ignore edits/commits necessary.
